title: Split Character Seed Cardinality Bound
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a subspace of $\bbf_2^d$, and let a binary subspace split of $H$ have complementary dimension $k$. The number of seeds $(x,y,h)\in\bbf_2^k\times\bbf_2^k\times H$ is at most $2^{3d}$.
